payload.purpose_context: Sub-epic #7549 (epic #7543): #7552 gives doctor coordination --fix a required Mission scope and Mission-branch-only discovery; #7498 pins the decisions runtime lock as runtime-only on every topology.
payload.purpose_tldr: doctor coordination --fix touches only the Missions named; the decisions runtime lock can never be committed to, survive as dirt in, or block a checkout.

payload.question: What should doctor coordination --fix do when no --mission is given?

payload.wp_title: doctor coordination acts only on the Missions named (#7552)
The decisions runtime lock is never dirt and never committed (#7498)
